objective: Design the music page for the Data Issue mix by Holly Herndon and Hannes Grassegger in the layout bones of the reference 1990s magazine party-photo collage page: section header, scattered snapshot collage with white borders, caption strip, short intro column.
reference_role: Reference image 1 is the layout authority: collage density, tilted white-bordered snapshots, header treatment, caption rhythm. None of its words or faces may appear. Reference image 2 supplies the sole photograph: a duotone portrait banner that becomes the largest collage element.
preservation_invariants: Keep the donor's structure: bold section header across the top, a dense collage of white-bordered photographs at varied angles, thin caption lines, one short text column.
Keep the shot-on-film snapshot quality: flash lighting, slight grain, period color.
canvas: Portrait magazine page, 3:4 aspect, warm paper white background.

The reference 2 photograph appears once as the largest, central collage element; every other collage frame is an abstract close-up texture of audio equipment, cables, mixers, and waveforms — no human faces.

regions.name: section header
regions.change: Top reads 'DATA IN THE MIX' in the donor's bold caps header style with a thin rule.

regions.name: title block
regions.change: 'MINNESANG: BITS AND ATOMS' in bold condensed caps with 'HOLLY HERNDON & HANNES GRASSEGGER' in small caps beneath.

regions.name: caption strip
regions.change: One thin caption line under the central photo reading 'A TALE OF BITS AND ATOMS, MIXED LIVE'.

regions.name: intro column
regions.change: One short column of greeked unreadable period body type.

style: Mid-1990s American music-magazine interior: heavy condensed and outlined display type, aggressive section headers, layered photo collage energy, warm coated-paper white, CMYK halftone grain.
Typography classification only: condensed grotesque display, outlined slab accents, small dense sans body columns; no digital-era fonts.
asset_rules: Use the photograph from reference image 2 exactly once as the page's primary art; crop is allowed, distortion and mirroring are not.
Ignore the flat gray matte surrounding the photograph in reference image 2; it is packing material, not content.
negative_constraints: No legible paragraph-length body text anywhere: running text must be greeked, soft-blurred print texture that is clearly type but unreadable at full size.
Do not reproduce the donor page's own photographs, advertisements, products, celebrities, phone numbers, or brand marks; the donor supplies layout bones and typographic idiom only.
No New York Magazine masthead, no VIBE masthead, no Newport/Absolut/Levi's or any real advertisement, no barcode with real digits, no real cover price.
No watermark, no border artifacts from the reference matte, no gray letterbox bars carried into the composition.
No misspelled masthead, no duplicated headline, no extra unrelated cover lines, no modern flat-UI aesthetic, no smartphone-era design elements.
No human faces other than those already present in the supplied reference 2 photograph.
quality_checks: At thumbnail size the page reads as an authentic mid-1990s printed magazine page: coated-paper tone, slight halftone grain, period type rendering.
Every exact-copy string is legible, spelled exactly as specified, and appears exactly once.
The transplanted DIS photograph is clearly recognizable and undistorted, integrated with period-correct print reproduction.
